description: Rothco’s P-51 Can Opener is the perfect compact and lightweight tool for outdoor enthusiasts and emergency preparedness. Made from durable stainless steel, this easy-to-use can opener is ideal for camping, hunting, backpacking, or any survival situation. Measuring approximately 2 inches long, the P-51 is slightly larger than the classic P-38, providing additional leverage and requiring less thumb pressure for efficient use. It can be conveniently stored in your bug-out bag, emergency kit, tackle box, or attached to your keychain or dog tag chain, taking up little to no space. Originally designed for opening large “tray rations,” the P-51’s durable construction ensures it can handle tough tasks with ease. Whether you're enjoying the great outdoors or preparing for an emergency, Rothco’s P-51 Can Opener is a reliable and practical addition to your gear.
